comment:
* Static library version of {@link android.util.LruCache}. Used to write apps
 * that run on API levels prior to 12. When running on API level 12 or above,
 * this implementation is still used; it does not try to switch to the
 * framework's implementation. See the framework SDK documentation for a class
 * overview.

variables.name: size
variables.comment: Size of this cache in units. Not necessarily the number of elements.

methods.name: public void resize(int maxSize)
methods.comment:
* Sets the size of the cache.
     *
     * @param maxSize The new maximum size.

methods.name: public final V get(K key)
methods.comment:
* Returns the value for {@code key} if it exists in the cache or can be
     * created by {@code #create}. If a value was returned, it is moved to the
     * head of the queue. This returns null if a value is not cached and cannot
     * be created.

methods.name: public final V put(K key, V value)
methods.comment:
* Caches {@code value} for {@code key}. The value is moved to the head of
     * the queue.
     *
     * @return the previous value mapped by {@code key}.

methods.name: public void trimToSize(int maxSize)
methods.comment:
* Remove the eldest entries until the total of remaining entries is at or
     * below the requested size.
     *
     * @param maxSize the maximum size of the cache before returning. May be -1
     *            to evict even 0-sized elements.

methods.name: public final V remove(K key)
methods.comment:
* Removes the entry for {@code key} if it exists.
     *
     * @return the previous value mapped by {@code key}.

methods.name: protected void entryRemoved(boolean evicted, K key, V oldValue, V newValue)
methods.comment:
* Called for entries that have been evicted or removed. This method is * invoked when a value is evicted to make space, removed by a call to * {@link #remove}, or replaced by a call to {@link #put}. The default * implementation does nothing. * *

The method is called without synchronization: other threads may * access the cache while this method is executing. * * @param evicted true if the entry is being removed to make space, false * if the removal was caused by a {@link #put} or {@link #remove}. * @param newValue the new value for {@code key}, if it exists. If non-null, * this removal was caused by a {@link #put}. Otherwise it was caused by * an eviction or a {@link #remove}.

methods.name: protected V create(K key)
methods.comment:
* Called after a cache miss to compute a value for the corresponding key. * Returns the computed value or null if no value can be computed. The * default implementation returns null. * *

The method is called without synchronization: other threads may * access the cache while this method is executing. * *

If a value for {@code key} exists in the cache when this method * returns, the created value will be released with {@link #entryRemoved} * and discarded. This can occur when multiple threads request the same key * at the same time (causing multiple values to be created), or when one * thread calls {@link #put} while another is creating a value for the same * key.

methods.name: private int safeSizeOf(K key, V value)
protected int sizeOf(K key, V value)
methods.comment:
* Returns the size of the entry for {@code key} and {@code value} in * user-defined units. The default implementation returns 1 so that size * is the number of entries and max size is the maximum number of entries. * *

An entry's size must not change while it is in the cache.

methods.name: public final void evictAll()
methods.comment: * Clear the cache, calling {@link #entryRemoved} on each removed entry.

methods.name: public final synchronized int size()
methods.comment:
* For caches that do not override {@link #sizeOf}, this returns the number
     * of entries in the cache. For all other caches, this returns the sum of
     * the sizes of the entries in this cache.

methods.name: public final synchronized int maxSize()
methods.comment:
* For caches that do not override {@link #sizeOf}, this returns the maximum
     * number of entries in the cache. For all other caches, this returns the
     * maximum sum of the sizes of the entries in this cache.

methods.name: public final synchronized int hitCount()
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of times {@link #get} returned a value that was
     * already present in the cache.

methods.name: public final synchronized int missCount()
methods.comment:
* Returns the number of times {@link #get} returned null or required a new
     * value to be created.

methods.name: public final synchronized int createCount()
methods.comment: * Returns the number of times {@link #create(Object)} returned a value.

methods.name: public final synchronized int putCount()
methods.comment: * Returns the number of times {@link #put} was called.

methods.name: public final synchronized int evictionCount()
methods.comment: * Returns the number of values that have been evicted.

methods.name: public final synchronized Map<K, V> snapshot()
methods.comment:
* Returns a copy of the current contents of the cache, ordered from least
     * recently accessed to most recently accessed.

methodNames: public final V put(K key, V value)
protected void entryRemoved(boolean evicted, K key, V oldValue, V newValue)
private int safeSizeOf(K key, V value)
protected int sizeOf(K key, V value)
